## CobbleDex scope check

- [ ] Answers a real Cobblemon knowledge question inside REI, JEI, or EMI

## Viewer parity

- [ ] REI support checked
- [ ] JEI support checked
- [ ] EMI support checked
- [ ] Reverse lookups checked where relevant

## Data and forms

## Testing
